description: This file defines the ClusterClient class in the Orleans framework, which manages communication with Orleans clusters, handles lifecycle events, and provides grain factory methods.

classes.name: ClusterClient
classes.description: Represents a client for communicating with Orleans clusters, managing lifecycle, and providing grain access methods.

methods.name: ClusterClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClusterClient with dependencies and registering lifecycle participants.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the runtime client and lifecycle asynchronously.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the lifecycle and runtime client asynchronously, with logging.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Various overloads to retrieve grain references by different primary key types.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates object references for grain observers and addressable objects.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes object references for grain observers.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget
methods.description: Retrieves system target grains by grain ID.
